sections.title: Announcement returns
sections.question: How does the stock react when the board fires the CEO, and does it matter who and why?
sections.interpretation: Over trading days -1 to +1, forced exits earn -1.6% (t = -4.33, N = 1,390) and retirements -0.1%. Fired founders earn -3.4% against -1.4% (gap p 0.154). Financial misconduct costs -6.4%, sex or relationship scandals -1.0% (gap p 0.043). Prices fall -5.7% over days -30 to -2 and are flat over days +2 to +60 (-0.5%).
